name: APEX-026-25 PHP Type Juggling Authentication Bypass
description: 一个存在宽松比较漏洞的PHP应用，其认证机制中，管理员密码哈希是一个“魔法哈希”，PHP在宽松比较时将其解释为零，从而允许使用任何同样产生魔法哈希的密码绕过认证。
hint: 登录验证使用MD5松散比较，寻找能产生0e开头哈希的特殊密码字符串

vulnerability.root_cause: Loose comparison (==) instead of strict comparison (===) for hash comparison

description.en: A PHP application with loose comparison vulnerability in authentication. The admin password hash is a 'magic hash' that PHP interprets as zero in loose comparisons, allowing bypass with any password that also produces a magic hash.

hint.en: 登录验证使用MD5松散比较，寻找能产生0e开头哈希的特殊密码字符串
